action_type_desc: Select the type of action to perform
button_display_style_desc: Choose a unified display style for all buttons in the panel
button_icon_desc: Upload, search, or enter an icon
button_name_invalid_chars: Button name cannot contain special characters < > : " / \ | ? *
button_panel_view_desc: Choose the display mode for the button panel: list view or tabs view
category_layout_desc: How the buttons of this category are arranged.
category_layout_flow_hint: Buttons follow each other and close up the gap when one is removed or hidden by a context rule.
category_layout_grid_hint: {slots} fixed slots. Every button keeps its position, and a button hidden by a context rule leaves its slot empty instead of moving the others. Arrange the slots by dragging buttons in sort mode.
category_layout_too_many_buttons: This category has {count} buttons but the grid only has {slots} slots. Remove or move buttons before switching to the grid layout.
conditions_desc: Show this button only when the rules below match the active note (applied in locked mode; in sort/edit mode hidden buttons stay visible and manageable). Leave empty to always show it.
context_status_contextual_inactive: Context rule — not matching right now, hidden in locked mode
grid_slot_empty_tooltip: Empty slot (row {row}, column {column}) — drag a button here
conditions_category_desc: Show this category only when the rules below match the active note and at least one of its buttons is visible (applied in locked mode; in sort/edit mode hidden categories stay visible and manageable). Leave empty to always show it.
conditions_empty_group_hint: Empty group — add a rule or group.
conditions_invalid_structure: Conditions JSON does not match the condition schema
conditions_incomplete: Conditions are incomplete — fill in all rule fields
confirm_delete_button: Are you sure you want to delete button "{buttonName}"?
confirm_delete_category: Are you sure you want to delete category "{categoryName}"?
create_paths_desc: Click to automatically create folders if they do not exist.
delete_button_warning: ⚠️ Warning: This action cannot be undone.
delete_category_warning: ⚠️ Warning: This category contains {buttonCount} buttons. Deleting the category will also delete all buttons!
enable_button_animation_desc: Enable hover animation effects for buttons
show_button_tooltip_desc: Display the full button name as a tooltip when hovering over a button
interaction_mode_desc: Locked: view only, all interactions disabled; Sort: long-press drag to reorder; Edit: context menu for editing
file_name_desc: Enter a file name (support date variable)
script_file_desc: Select a JavaScript file to run
script_file_empty: Script file path cannot be empty
script_folder_desc: Folder path for storing script files
script_invalid_export:
Invalid script export. Use module.exports = { entry: main, ... } and make sure entry is a function. Please check your script:
{scriptFileName}
folder_name_editable_desc: Click the folder name to edit when expanded
folder_show_btn_count_desc: Display the number of buttons on the folder tile
folder_close_on_blank_desc: Click on any empty area inside the expanded folder to close it
template_folder_desc: Folder path for storing template files
no_categories_hint: No categories yet, switch to edit mode to add
no_buttons_in_category: No buttons yet, switch to edit mode to add
stop_on_error_desc: Whether to stop executing subsequent actions when one fails
delay_between_actions_desc: Delay time between actions in sequential execution (milliseconds)
sequence_stopped_on_error: Action sequence stopped due to error
only_sequential_effective: This option is only effective in sequential mode
show_top_nav_bar_desc: Control the display/hide of top navigation bar
tabs_wrap_desc: When enabled, tabs will automatically wrap to the next line based on page width instead of horizontal scrolling
auto_collapse_list_view_desc: When enabled, each time you open list view, all categories start collapsed
